reason: A read-only Web GUI profiler that folds persisted agent session events into timelines, execution summaries, performance metrics, and error or retry traces.

summaries.zh: 这是一个只读的智能体运行时分析插件，可在 Web GUI 中展示会话步骤、工具调用、耗时、重试、错误和令牌使用情况。
summaries.en: A read-only agent runtime profiler that displays session steps, tool calls, timing, retries, errors, and token usage in a Web GUI.

capabilities: Aggregates agent turns, steps, model calls, tool calls, retries, errors, timing, and token usage
Displays runtime traces and performance summaries in a Web GUI DevTools panel
Provides an RPC endpoint for runtime trace snapshots
